The agent must first locate a magenta banner, which serves as a landmark indicating the location of a building/structure that contains an oak door. Once the agent finds the magenta banner and navigates to the structure it marks, they can then mine (break) the oak door. This creates a natural dependency: the agent needs to find the visual landmark (magenta banner) to know where the oak door is located, making the navigation meaningful rather than random exploration. Both tasks are observable and verifiable - finding the banner requires visual recognition, and mining the door produces a collectible item and changes block state.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the magenta banner and face it to confirm visual identification. The banner is at spawn-relative (7, 3, 4) on top of a cobblestone pillar marking the cabin entrance. Max distance of 10 blocks ensures the player is close enough to have clearly seen it, and 60° facing tolerance confirms they are looking toward it.

Uses inventory_has because mining the oak door causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. When either half of a two-block-tall door is broken, the entire door drops as one 'oak_door' item. This is the most direct and reliable check for confirming the door was successfully mined.

A cobblestone pillar with a magenta banner stands directly in front of the door as a landmark. Two torches flank the pillar for visibility. The player spawns with a wooden axe to mine the door.
task_text: Find the magenta banner that marks a small cabin, then mine the oak door on the cabin's entrance.
design_notes: Building at ~7,0,~7 center (relative). Door at ~7,0,~5 facing south. Banner pillar at ~7,0,~4 (one block in front of door). Player spawns at origin facing the building. The banner is elevated (y+3) for visibility from distance. Torches at ground level flank the pillar. Wooden axe provided for efficient door mining. The cobblestone pillar is intentionally in front of the door — player must approach from slightly to the side to access the door.
